topics: Query Processing and Optimization - Measures of query cost
Algorithms for Selection with cost analysis
Algorithms for Join with cost analysis
Heuristics in Query Optimization - Optimization of Relational Algebra expressions
Physical Database Design and Tuning - Introduction to Physical Database Design
Distributed Databases  - Distributed Systems, Introduction, Architecture
Query Processing and Decomposition - Query Processing Objectives
XML and Non Relational Databases - Introduction to Semi Structured Data and XML Databases
MongoDB Operation - Insert, Update, Delete, Query, Indexing, Application, Replication, Sharding, Deployment
Cassandra - Data Model, Key Space, Table Operations, CRUD Operations

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module.  Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks.  Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 3 subdivisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Apply  various measures for query processing and optimization, and apply techniques to tune database performance.
Explain the architecture and fundamental concepts of distributed databases.
Utilize semi-structured data, XML, and XML queries for effective data management
Utilize NoSQL database systems to manage and manipulate data in real-time applications
Develop advanced skills in graph database concepts, covering data modeling, application building, and the application of graph theory for predictive analysis and modeling.
